ops.quote: Deep neural networks (DNN) have recently proven to be effective on person re-identification task.
diffusing the similarities among the gallery images in an end-to-end manner has proven to be effective
the probe image is taken as a constraint (seed) and each cluster corresponds to a set of images corresponding to the same person
optimizing the constrained clustering in an end-to-end manner
finding a constrained cluster, where the probe image is taken as a constraint (seed) and each cluster corresponds to a set of images corresponding to the same person
we re-formulate person re-id problem as finding a constrained cluster
we further enhance the performance by integrating an auxiliary net alongside DCDS
we naturally leverage the contextual knowledge of a set of images corresponding to the given person-images
